title: Chat
description: Talk with agents. Start a chat on any runtime and worker, in a workspace or without one, and follow every turn as it runs.

dependencies.reason: Claude Code is a runtime to chat with.
OpenCode is a runtime to chat with.
A chat can work in its own git worktree of a repository.
A chat can work in a directory of its own.

desktop.title: Chat
desktop.description: Your chats with agents, each beside the list of the others.

panel.title: Chat
panel.description: Your chats with agents, one at a time.

actions.title: New chat
actions.description: Opens Chat on a new chat, where a person writes the first prompt and chooses the runtime, worker, model and workspace.

actions.title: Start a chat
actions.description: Starts a chat with an agent on the given runtime and worker, sends it the prompt, and opens it in Chat.

input.label: Title
input.description: Named from the prompt when left empty.

actions.title: Send to a chat
actions.description: Sends a prompt to a chat's agent, resuming the chat first if it was released. The prompt waits its turn while the agent is busy.

actions.title: Release chat
actions.description: Stops a chat's agent and frees its workspace slot. The conversation is kept, and the next prompt resumes it.

methods.title: Create chat
methods.description: Starts a chat: a public session on a runtime and worker, optionally in a workspace, recorded in Chat. Input: runtimeId and workerId (strings, required); title (string); model ({ modelId, settings }); agentDefinitionId and personaId (strings); workspace, either { workspaceId } for an existing workspace on that worker or { workspaceProvisionerId, name?, base? } to mount one, which Chat unmounts when the chat is released; prompt (a string or prompt content parts) to send at once. Answers { chatId, sessionId, turn: { turnId, queued } or null }.

methods.title: Prompt chat
methods.description: Sends a prompt to a chat's agent. A released chat, or one whose session ended, is resumed first on a fresh session that continues the same conversation. A prompt sent while a turn runs is queued, the latest replacing any earlier queued one. Input: chatId (string), prompt (a string or prompt content parts). Answers { sessionId, turnId, queued }.

methods.title: Resume chat
methods.description: Starts a released chat again on a fresh session that continues its conversation, mounting its workspace if needed. Does nothing to a chat that is running. Input: chatId (string). Answers { sessionId }.

methods.title: Release chat
methods.description: Stops a chat's agent, ends its session and frees its workspace slot, keeping the conversation so the chat can resume. Input: chatId (string). Answers { released }, false when it was not running.

methods.title: Remove chat
methods.description: Releases a chat and removes it from Chat. Its workspace and the agent's own record of the conversation stay. Input: chatId (string). Answers { removed: true }.

methods.title: List chats
methods.description: Every chat in Chat, most recently prompted first, each with its id, title, runtimeId, workerId, workspace, model, sessionId (null when released), agentSessionId, createdAt, lastPromptAt and releasedAt. Input: none. Answers { chats }.
